title: How Your Phone Unlocks With Your Face 🔓 Face Unlock in 60 Seconds #shorts
description:
Secure face unlock doesn't just take a photo. A projector beams thousands of invisible infrared dots onto your face, an infrared camera reads how the dots bend, and that builds a 3D depth map. A neural network turns the map into a mathematical description and compares it with the one stored in a secure chip on your phone. It works in the dark, and a flat photo can't fool it because a photo has no depth.

📘 More to learn + my projects: https://github.com/HemashreeVI

#FaceID #ComputerVision #Smartphone #Security #AI #TechExplained #shorts

lines: You glance at your phone, and it unlocks. Even in the dark. But a photo of you won't work.
A tiny projector beams thousands of invisible infrared dots onto your face.
An infrared camera reads how those dots bend around your nose, cheeks and eyes, and builds a 3D depth map.
A neural network turns that map into numbers, and compares them with the ones stored in a secure chip on your phone. Match, and it unlocks.
A photo is flat. No depth, no match. That's why holding up a picture doesn't work.
Not a photo. A 3D map of your face.
